name: Fulleda (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with a red Calvary cross on a stepped base, its arms extended to the hoist and fly edges.
history: The official flag of Fulleda is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with a red Calvary cross at the centre with arms of thickness 1/6 of the height of the cloth, the upright 3/4 of the height of the cloth; approved on 1 July 1996.

features.role: Calvary cross on a stepped base with its crossbar reaching the edges
